scope: bounded diagnostic at first output divergence; not universal bit parity
requirements: original target backend sampling disabled and diagnostic reproduces original IDs
same actual reached prefix and positions through the first divergence
both competing IDs present in both raw top-five lists
opposing close margins; eligible raw argmax equals each actual sampled/emitted token
valid causal verification and retained-cache ancestry
on_pass: Proceed with native comparison and explicit near-tie sensitivity/output-ID caveat; no proof that batch arithmetic is the cause.
on_fail: Hold affected arm for a focused correctness fix; do not change model precision/verifier or call fallback a scientific result.
